purpose: Autonomous research pipeline using BLCO intel enrichment, Open Empire PMO research engine, and the Knowledge Graph (KG) to discover, enrich, and implement data-driven decisions. Combines web research, entity enrichment, and KG storage for persistent structured intelligence.
model_policy: Free models (command-r7b, nemotron) for bulk enrichment; Haiku for synthesis
startup: kg-api always-on; blco-enricher on-demand; nexus-telemetry continuous
health_check: curl -sm 3 http://127.0.0.1:6279/health && psql ... -c 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kg_entities;'
validation: PASS: kg-api running, 58 entities in KG, research_enricher.py exists, intel dir populated
approval_gates: Nathan approval for enrichment campaigns over $1 spend
rollback: Restore KG from clawdb backup; re-run enricher from leads.jsonl
kpi: Entities enriched / contact resolution rate / KG growth per week
